$comment: 语法大厅 G45（V0.9 P4 精修层）。比喻锚点：打聚光灯：把某个乐手单独照亮。与 G29 的「聚光灯换人」明确区分：G29 换的是主语（被动），G45 只是把某个成分照亮（强调），句子真假不变。只讲初中层面：It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who、时态二选一、摘框检验法、强调时间地点仍用 that、not until 强调、谓语强调用 do。KET 不考，据实标注。全部内容原创。
title: 强调句 It is ... that ...
metaphor: 打聚光灯：把某个乐手单独照亮
ketNote: 老实说：KET 不考强调句。这一课是为初中/PET 打底——初中考试里「that 还是 when」「is 还是 was」是高频选择题。不用焦虑，学到就是赚到。

sections.essence: 聚光灯句框：It is/was + 要照亮的部分 + that + 其余，句意不变，重点变了。
sections.why: 中文想强调什么，把嗓门落在哪儿就行：「是汤姆打碎了窗户」「我是昨天见到他的」——加个「是」，或者干脆靠重读。英语的书面语没法标重音，于是造了一个专用句框：It is/was + 要强调的部分 + that + 剩下的话。想突出人，就把人放进框里：It was Tom that broke the window（打碎窗户的是汤姆，不是别人）；想突出时间：It was yesterday that I met him（是昨天，不是前天）。句子的事实一点没变，变的只是聚光灯的落点。注意它和 G29 被动的区别：被动是把挨动作的一方换成主语，动词要换装；强调句谁也不换装，只是搭一个灯架，把某个成分抬进光圈。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐队合奏时，一百多人同时在响。有观众问灯光师傅：「我想让大家只注意第一小提琴，怎么办？」师傅说：「简单，打一束追光。」咔哒一声，It was 的灯架立起来，第一小提琴被抬进光圈，that 后面的乐队继续原样演奏——音乐没改一个音，观众的眼睛却全过去了。师傅教学徒两条规矩：「第一，灯架分今晚和昨晚两种——原句说的是现在将来，用 It is；说的是过去，用 It was。第二，验灯要拆架：把 It is 和 that 摘掉，剩下的词必须能拼回原来那句话——拼得回，才是真追光；拼不回，你搭的就不是灯架，是别的东西。」学徒又问：「能把『演奏』这个动作抬进光圈吗？」师傅摇头：「动词是正在干活的人，抬不动——想强调动作，去借 G12 的起拍手势：He did come，did 一挥，动作自然重了。」

cards.rule: 句框：It is / was + 被强调部分 + that + 其余
cards.detail: 把想突出的成分抬进光圈，剩下的话原封不动跟在 that 后面。被强调的是人时，that 也可换 who。
cards.example: It was Tom that/who broke the window.

cards.rule: is 还是 was：看原句的时态
cards.detail: 原句说过去的事用 It was，说现在或将来的事用 It is——只有这两个选项，不跟着从句乱变。
cards.example: It is my mum that cooks every day. ／ It was last week that we moved in.

cards.rule: 强调时间地点，照样用 that
cards.detail: 初中最爱考的坑：光圈里放的是时间或地点，后面仍然用 that——不用 when，不用 where。
cards.example: It was in the park that I lost my keys.（✗ where）

cards.detail: 把 It is/was 和 that 摘掉，剩下的词能拼回一句完整的原话，才是强调句；拼不回，就是定语从句或别的结构。
cards.example: It was yesterday that she left. → She left yesterday. ✔

cards.rule: not ... until 的强调：It was not until ... that ...
cards.detail: 「直到……才……」整块搬进光圈时，not 跟着 until 走，that 后面的动词转回肯定。
cards.example: It was not until midnight that he finished the model.

cards.rule: 谓语动词抬不进光圈：用 do/does/did 强调
cards.detail: 动作本身要加重，不用句框，请 G12 的手势帮忙：do/does/did + 原形。
cards.example: He did come to the rehearsal — I saw him!

basic.en: It was Tom that broke the cup.
basic.cn: 打碎杯子的是汤姆。（灯照在人身上）

basic.en: It is my dad that drives me to school.
basic.cn: 开车送我上学的是我爸爸。（现在的习惯用 is）

basic.en: It was yesterday that we met the writer.
basic.cn: 我们是昨天见到那位作家的。（灯照在时间上）

basic.en: It was in the library that I found the letter.
basic.cn: 我是在图书馆发现那封信的。（灯照在地点上，仍用 that）

basic.en: It was the ending that moved everyone.
basic.cn: 打动所有人的是结尾。（灯照在事物上）

mid.en: It was my grandma who taught me this song.
mid.cn: 教我这首歌的是我奶奶。（强调人可用 who）

mid.en: It is the details that make a story alive.
mid.cn: 让故事活起来的是细节。（that 后动词跟被强调的复数对齐）

mid.en: It was not until last month that the bridge was finished.
mid.cn: 直到上个月这座桥才完工。（not until 整块进光圈）

mid.en: It was because of the rain that the match was put off.
mid.cn: 比赛是因为下雨才推迟的。（原因也能进光圈）

mid.en: Was it you that left the window open?
mid.cn: 把窗户开着没关的是你吗？（灯架也能改成疑问）

trap.en: It was at the gate that we said goodbye.
trap.cn: 我们是在大门口道别的。
trap.note: 地点进光圈仍用 that——写 where 就从灯架变成别的从句了。

trap.en: It was on Monday that the show began.
trap.note: 时间进光圈也用 that——不用 when。

trap.en: It is Lucy who waters the flowers every day.
trap.note: 原句是现在的习惯——用 It is，别看见「每天」就慌。

trap.en: He did finish the homework — check his notebook.
trap.cn: 他确实写完作业了——去看他本子。
trap.note: 强调动词不用句框，用 did + 原形。

trap.en: It was I that made the mistake.（口语常说 It was me）
trap.note: It was me that... 口语完全通行；书面 It was I 更正式，两个都算对。

trap.en: It was the twins that were singing upstairs.
trap.cn: 在楼上唱歌的是那对双胞胎。
trap.note: that 后的动词跟被强调的主语对齐——twins 复数配 were。

redBlack.bad: It was Tom that he broke the window.（想说：打碎窗户的是汤姆）
redBlack.good: It was Tom that broke the window.
redBlack.why: Tom 进了光圈，原位还留了个 he——听的人分不清 Tom 和 he 是不是一个人，谁闯的祸糊了。

redBlack.bad: Was my sister that paid for the tickets.（想强调是姐姐付的钱）
redBlack.good: It was my sister that paid for the tickets.
redBlack.why: 灯架少了 It，句子成了没头的疑问句——听的人以为你在提问，话意全拧。

redBlack.bad: It was in the museum where I saw the old violin.
redBlack.good: It was in the museum that I saw the old violin.
redBlack.why: 强调地点仍用 that——where 是初中考试最爱挖的坑。

redBlack.bad: It was last Sunday when we planted the trees.
redBlack.good: It was last Sunday that we planted the trees.
redBlack.why: 强调时间也用 that——不用 when。

redBlack.bad: It is last year that they built the new gym.
redBlack.good: It was last year that they built the new gym.
redBlack.why: 原句是过去的事——灯架要用昨晚款 It was。

redBlack.bad: It was Miss Chen which taught us to skate.
redBlack.good: It was Miss Chen that/who taught us to skate.
redBlack.why: 强调人用 that 或 who——which 进不了这个灯架。

redBlack.bad: It was until ten o'clock that Dad came home.（想说：直到十点才回来）
redBlack.good: It was not until ten o'clock that Dad came home.
redBlack.why: 「直到……才」进光圈要整块搬——not 跟着 until 走，丢了 not 意思就断了。

redBlack.bad: It is the students that likes the new playground most.
redBlack.good: It is the students that like the new playground most.
redBlack.why: that 后的动词跟被强调的 students 对齐——复数不加 -s。

redBlack.bad: It was very carefully that checked the answers.（想说：他检查得非常仔细）
redBlack.good: He checked the answers very carefully. / He did check the answers carefully.
redBlack.why: 拆架检验不过关——摘掉框剩不下完整的话；想加重动作，请 did 出手。

redBlack.bad: It was yesterday that I did saw him.
redBlack.good: It was yesterday that I saw him.
redBlack.why: 灯架和 did 两种强调别叠着用——that 后面的话保持原样。

redBlack.bad: It was me that forgot the key.（有人说必须写 It was I）
redBlack.good: It was me that... 口语通行，It was I that... 更正式，都对。
redBlack.why: 光圈里用 me 还是 I 不挡意思，考试也不设坑——别互相纠正。

redBlack.bad: It's my mum that makes breakfast.（有人说强调句不能缩写）
redBlack.good: It's = It is，缩写完全合法。
redBlack.why: It's 起头的强调句天天见——不挡意思不算错。

contrast.cn: 是汤姆打碎了窗户。（加个「是」）
contrast.en: It was Tom that broke the window.（搭整套灯架）
contrast.diff: 中文一个「是」字就能点亮；英语要搭 It was...that 的完整句框。

contrast.cn: 我昨天见的是他。（语序挪一挪）
contrast.en: It was him that I met yesterday.
contrast.diff: 中文靠挪语序和重读；英语把强调做成了固定建筑。

contrast.cn: 我是在公园丢的钥匙。（「是……的」句式）
contrast.en: It was in the park that I lost my keys.
contrast.diff: 中文「是……的」和英语 It was...that 异曲同工——但英语的 that 永不换人，中文的「的」也从不挪窝。

contrast.en: He did come.（借 did 加重）
contrast.diff: 中文给动词加副词；英语给动词派一个专职加重的 do——动词进不了 It is...that 的光圈。

contrast.cn: 直到半夜他才做完。（「直到……才」）
contrast.en: It was not until midnight that he finished.
contrast.diff: 中文的「才」自带转折；英语要把 not until 整块抬进光圈，that 后转回肯定。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 抬进光圈三步走：挑成分、选 is/was、that 收口；拆架能还原才是真强调，时间地点照样 that。
steps: 想突出哪个成分（人/物/时间/地点/原因），把它整块抬进 It is/was ___ that 的光圈。
选灯架：原句讲过去 → It was；讲现在或将来 → It is。只有这两款。
收口一律用 that；被强调的是人，才可以换 who——when/where/which 都进不了灯架。
自查拆架：摘掉 It is/was 和 that，剩下的词拼得回原句才合格。
that 后的动词跟被强调的主语对齐（复数配复数），别多留代词复本。
想强调动词本身？句框不管这事——用 do/does/did + 原形（G12 的手势兼职）。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，咱们玩『追光灯游戏』：我说一句平常的话，比如『汤姆昨天在操场丢了外套』，然后我喊一个词——『谁！』你就把灯打给人：It was Tom that lost his coat；我喊『哪儿！』你就把灯打给地点：It was on the playground that...；我喊『什么时候！』你打给时间。我不懂英语没关系，我只当验灯员，听两件事：句子是不是 It was（或 It is）起的头、中间过后有没有 that 这个音。两样都齐，追光就算打成了。」再玩拆架关：孩子说完强调句，让她把 It was 和 that 摘掉，用剩下的词把原句复原说一遍——拼得回去，说明灯架搭得正。
questions: 想强调「是谁」干的，英语的灯架怎么搭？哪两个词是灯架的固定零件？
强调时间和地点的时候，that 能不能换成 when 或 where？
想强调「确实做了」这个动作本身，还用这个句框吗？该请谁帮忙？

sections.echo: 灯架的两个固定零件，恰好是英语兼职最多的两个小词。it 的职务清单在 G37 已经列过一轮：真代词、天气官、占位报幕员——现在再添一行「聚光灯支架」。that 更夸张：指示词「那个」、G33 的安全带、G34 的连音线，到这一课又当上灯架的收口螺丝。为什么总是它俩？因为语言造新句式时，从不铸造新零件，只把手边用得最顺的旧零件再拧一个用途——用得越勤的词，被拧的次数越多，职务越攒越长。「越常用越不讲理」说到底是「越常用越被重用」：it 和 that 的兼职清单，就是这条定律最直观的账本。

memoryCard.alt: G45 记忆卡：强调句=打追光。句框 It is/was+被强调部分+that+其余（人可用 who）；is/was 看原句时态；时间地点照样用 that 不用 when/where；拆架检验法摘框还原；not until 整块进光圈；强调动词用 do/does/did；警示 where/when 混入、原位留代词、which 强调人、丢 not 四类错误；KET 不考，为初中/PET 打底。

questions.q: It was Tom that broke the cup. 这束追光照在什么上？
options: 人（Tom）
杯子
时间
questions.explain: 光圈里站着谁，灯就照谁——Tom 被单独照亮。

questions.q: It was yesterday that we met the coach. 光圈里是什么？
options: 时间（yesterday）
人（the coach）
动作（met）
questions.explain: It was 和 that 之间夹着的就是被照亮的——yesterday。

questions.q: 强调句的固定句框是？
options: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that + 其余
There is/was + 名词 + that
It is/was + that + 被强调部分
questions.explain: 灯架三件套：It is/was、光圈里的成分、that 收口。

questions.q: 强调句改变句子的事实吗？
options: 不变——只变重点
变——动作换了人
变——时间挪了
questions.explain: 追光不改音乐——事实原样，观众的注意力换了地方。

questions.q: 原句说的是过去的事，灯架用哪一款？
options: It was
It is
It were
questions.explain: 过去款 It was，现在将来款 It is——只有这两款。

questions.q: 被强调的是人时，that 还可以换成？
options: who
which
where
questions.explain: 人可用 who——which 进不了灯架。

questions.q: 强调地点时，收口用哪个词？
options: 仍然用 that
换成 where
换成 which
questions.explain: 初中最爱考的坑——时间地点进光圈，照样 that。

questions.q: 「拆架检验法」怎么操作？
options: 摘掉 It is/was 和 that，看剩下的词能否拼回原句
把 that 换成 which 试试
数一数单词个数
questions.explain: 拼得回是真灯架，拼不回是别的结构。

questions.q: It was in the park that I lost my keys. 摘掉灯架还原成？
options: I lost my keys in the park.
The park lost my keys.
In the park was my keys.
questions.explain: 剩下的词严丝合缝拼回原句——检验通过。

questions.q: 谓语动词能不能抬进 It is...that 的光圈？
options: 不能——强调动词要用 do/does/did
能，直接放进去
加 -ing 就能
questions.explain: 动词正在干活抬不动——请 G12 的手势 did 加重它。

questions.q: He did come to the meeting. 里的 did 是干什么的？
options: 加重 come——他「确实」来了
表示过去疑问
多余的词
questions.explain: do/does/did + 原形是动词专用的加重器。

questions.q: 「直到十点才回家」进光圈后，not 去哪了？
options: 跟着 until 走——It was not until ten that...
留在 that 后面
消失了
questions.explain: not until 整块搬家，that 后面转回肯定。

questions.q: G29 的聚光灯和本课的聚光灯有什么不同？
options: G29 换主语动词换装；本课只照亮不换装
完全一样
本课的灯要换动词
questions.explain: 被动是换人上句首；强调只是搭灯架，谁也不动。

questions.q: It is my mum that cooks dinner every day. 为什么用 It is？
options: 原句是现在的习惯
mum 是单数
cooks 有 -s
questions.explain: is/was 只看原句时间——每天做饭是现在的习惯。

questions.q: 下面哪句是强调句？
options: It was the song that woke me up.
It is a song that has three parts.
It rains a lot in June.
questions.explain: 拆架检验：The song woke me up ✔；第二句摘掉后拼不回完整原话——那是定语从句。

questions.q: 强调句里 that 后面的部分要怎么处理？
options: 原封不动跟上，不再留被强调成分的复本
换成疑问语序
全部改过去时
questions.explain: 光圈外的乐队照常演奏——原样跟上，别留代词复本。

stages.name: 选一选 · is 还是 was

questions.q: ___ my deskmate that lent me the ruler just now.
options: It was
It is
It were
questions.explain: just now 是过去——It was。

questions.q: It ___ my grandpa that waters the plants every morning.
options: is
was
be
questions.explain: 每天早上的习惯——现在款 It is。

questions.q: It was in the music room ___ we practised the duet.
options: that
where
which
questions.explain: 地点进光圈仍用 that——where 是坑。

questions.q: It was on Saturday ___ the book fair opened.
options: that
when
which
questions.explain: 时间进光圈也用 that——不用 when。

questions.q: It was Miss Gao ___ told us the good news.
options: who
which
where
questions.explain: 强调人可用 who（that 也行）——which 不行。

questions.q: It was the noise outside ___ woke the baby.
options: that
who
when
questions.explain: 强调事物用 that。

questions.q: It was ___ that Dad finally came home.
options: not until midnight
until midnight
midnight until
questions.explain: 「直到才」整块进光圈——not until midnight。

questions.q: It is the small habits ___ shape our days.
options: that
when
whose
questions.explain: 强调复数事物照样 that——后面动词已与复数对齐。

questions.q: He ___ finish the race — I watched him cross the line!
options: did
was
is
questions.explain: 强调动词用 did + 原形——「确实跑完了」。

questions.q: ___ because of the fog that our flight was delayed.
options: It was
It is
That was
questions.explain: 航班延误是过去的事——It was；原因也能进光圈。

questions.q: It was my cousin ___ I taught to ride a bike.
options: that
which
where
questions.explain: 强调宾语（人）——that/who 皆可，选 that。

questions.q: It ___ next Monday that the new library opens.
options: is
was
were
questions.explain: 下周一是将来——现在款 It is。

questions.q: It was at the school gate ___ the twins said goodbye.
options: that
where
when
questions.explain: 地点照样 that——拆架还原：The twins said goodbye at the school gate。

questions.q: It was the two pandas ___ drew the biggest crowd.
options: that
who
when
questions.explain: 动物用 that；后面动词与复数对齐。

questions.q: She ___ lock the door — I heard the click.
options: did
was
does
questions.explain: 过去的动作加重用 did——「确实锁了」。

questions.q: It was not until the rain stopped ___ we set off.
options: that
when
then
questions.explain: not until 的灯架照样用 that 收口。

questions.q: 哪句灯架搭对了？（我是在书店遇见老师的）
options: It was in the bookshop that I met my teacher.
It was in the bookshop where I met my teacher.
It was in the bookshop which I met my teacher.
questions.explain: 地点进光圈用 that——where/which 都是冒牌螺丝。

questions.q: 哪句灯架搭对了？（打电话的是我姐姐）
options: It was my sister that made the call.
It was my sister which made the call.
Was my sister that made the call.
questions.explain: 人用 that/who；It 是灯架的地基不能丢。

questions.q: 哪句时态选对了？（他们是去年搬来的）
options: It was last year that they moved here.
It is last year that they moved here.
It were last year that they moved here.
questions.explain: 去年是过去——It was。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（每天叫我起床的是闹钟不是妈妈）
options: It is the alarm clock that wakes me up, not Mum.
It was the alarm clock that wakes me up, not Mum.
It is the alarm clock who wakes me up, not Mum.
questions.explain: 现在的习惯用 It is；闹钟不是人，用 that。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（直到灯全灭了演出才开始）
options: It was not until all the lights went out that the show began.
It was until all the lights went out that the show began.
It was not until all the lights went out when the show began.
questions.explain: not 不能丢，收口仍是 that。

questions.q: 哪句没有多余的复本？（是这首诗打动了评委）
options: It was this poem that touched the judges.
It was this poem that it touched the judges.
It was this poem that the poem touched the judges.
questions.explain: 光圈外不留复本——that 后面直接接 touched。

questions.q: 哪句主谓对齐了？（最先到的是那几个志愿者）
options: It was the volunteers that were the first to arrive.
It was the volunteers that was the first to arrive.
It were the volunteers that were the first to arrive.
questions.explain: 灯架永远 It was；that 后动词跟 volunteers 对齐用 were。

questions.q: 哪句强调动词强调对了？（她确实道过歉）
options: She did apologize.
It was apologize that she did.
She did apologized.
questions.explain: 动词进不了光圈——did + 原形 apologize。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（我们是在午饭后出发的）
options: It was after lunch that we set off.
It was after lunch when we set off.
It is after lunch that we set off.
questions.explain: 时间进光圈用 that；出发是过去——It was。

questions.q: 哪句拆架检验能通过？
options: It was the wind that blew the door shut.
It was the wind that the door shut.
It was the wind that it blew the door shut.
questions.explain: 摘框还原：The wind blew the door shut ✔——另两句拼不回完整原句。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（教我折纸鹤的是外婆）
options: It was my grandma who showed me how to fold paper cranes.
It was my grandma when showed me how to fold paper cranes.
It was my grandma which showed me how to fold paper cranes.
questions.explain: 人进光圈——who/that 二选一。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（是下周五交读书报告）
options: It is next Friday that the book reports are due.
It was next Friday that the book reports are due.
It is next Friday when the book reports are due.
questions.explain: 下周五是将来——It is；收口 that。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（比赛是因为大雪才取消的）
options: It was because of the heavy snow that the race was called off.
It was because of the heavy snow why the race was called off.
It was because of the heavy snow which the race was called off.
questions.explain: 原因进光圈照样 that 收口。

questions.q: 哪句两种强调没混用？（他确实是昨天来的）
options: It was yesterday that he came.
It was yesterday that he did came.
It was yesterday that he did come came.
questions.explain: 灯架和 did 二选一——that 后保持原样 he came。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（在门口等你的是快递员）
options: It is the delivery man that is waiting for you at the door.
It is the delivery man that waiting for you at the door.
Is the delivery man that is waiting at the door.
questions.explain: that 后要有完整谓语 is waiting；It 地基不能丢。

questions.q: 哪句写对了？（直到今天早上我才发现字条）
options: It was not until this morning that I found the note.
It was not until this morning when I found the note.
It is not until this morning that I found the note.
questions.explain: 发现是过去——It was；not until + that 一件不能少。

questions.q: 老师问：到底是谁擦的黑板？你想强调是莉莉——
options: It was Lily that cleaned the blackboard.
Lily it was that cleaned the blackboard.
It was Lily cleaned the blackboard.
questions.explain: 标准灯架：It was + Lily + that + 其余。

questions.q: 同学以为你在操场丢的水壶，其实是在食堂——你纠正：
options: It was in the dining hall that I lost my bottle, not on the playground.
It was in the dining hall where I lost my bottle, not on the playground.
It was the dining hall lost my bottle.
questions.explain: 纠正地点最适合打追光——收口仍是 that。

questions.q: 原句：The cold water woke him up. 强调 the cold water——
options: It was the cold water that woke him up.
It was the cold water when woke him up.
It was woke him up that the cold water.
questions.explain: 抬主语进光圈，that 后接 woke him up。

questions.q: 原句：We visit Grandma on Sundays. 强调 on Sundays——
options: It is on Sundays that we visit Grandma.
It was on Sundays that we visit Grandma.
It is on Sundays when we visit Grandma.
questions.explain: 现在的习惯用 It is；时间照样 that。

questions.q: 妈妈不信你交了作业，你加重语气：
options: I did hand in my homework!
It was hand in that I did my homework!
I did handed in my homework!
questions.explain: 强调动作——did + 原形 hand in。

questions.q: 「直到演出结束他才看手机」——哪句对？
options: It was not until the show ended that he checked his phone.
It was until the show ended that he checked his phone.
It was not until the show ended when he checked his phone.
questions.explain: not until 整块进光圈，that 收口。

questions.q: 拆架检验：哪一句摘掉 It was 和 that 后能拼回完整原句？
options: It was the map that led us out of the forest.
It was the map that we needed a guide.
It was the map that out of the forest.
questions.explain: The map led us out of the forest ✔——另两句是散架的。

questions.q: — Was it you ___ drew this poster? — Yes, it was me.
options: that
when
whose
questions.explain: 疑问灯架照样 that 收口；答句 it was me 口语通行。

questions.q: 原句：Grandpa planted this tree forty years ago. 强调 forty years ago——
options: It was forty years ago that Grandpa planted this tree.
It is forty years ago that Grandpa planted this tree.
It was forty years ago when Grandpa planted this tree.
questions.explain: 过去款 It was + 时间 + that。

questions.q: 哪句能听出「不是别人，偏偏是校长」的味道？
options: It was the headmaster himself that opened the door for us.
The headmaster opened the door for us.
The door was opened by the headmaster.
questions.explain: 追光一打，「偏偏是他」的意味就出来了——第三句只是换灯（被动），重点在门。

questions.q: It is the quiet readers ___ often surprise us most.
options: that
when
which
questions.explain: 强调人——that（或 who）。

questions.q: 你想说「我确实每天练琴」，选哪句？
options: I do practise the piano every day.
It is practise that I do the piano.
I do practising the piano every day.
questions.explain: 现在的动作加重用 do + 原形。

questions.q: 原句：The story ends in spring. 强调 in spring——
options: It is in spring that the story ends.
It was in spring that the story ends.
It is in spring when the story ends.
questions.explain: 故事「现在」这么写着——It is + that。

questions.q: 哪一句不是强调句？（拆架检验）
options: It is a fact that the earth goes round the sun.
It was the sun that lit up the whole valley.
It was this song that started the concert.
questions.explain: 第一句摘框后 A fact the earth goes round the sun 拼不回原句——它是 It 作形式主语（G37 的老朋友）。

questions.q: 同桌说是风吹倒了自行车，你强调其实是那只猫——
options: It was the cat, not the wind, that knocked over the bike.
It was the cat, not the wind, which knocked over the bike.
The cat it was not the wind that knocked the bike.
questions.explain: 对比纠正打追光——that 收口，which 进不了灯架。

questions.q: 大考：原句 He didn't tell me the truth until yesterday. 打追光强调时间——
options: It was not until yesterday that he told me the truth.
It was until yesterday that he didn't tell me the truth.
It was not until yesterday when he told me the truth.
questions.explain: not 跟着 until 进光圈，that 后转回肯定 told——三个零件一个不能错。

detective.sentence: It was in the library where I left my schoolbag.
detective.fixed: It was in the library that I left my schoolbag.
detective.clue: 地点进光圈收口仍用 that——where 是混进灯架的冒牌螺丝。

detective.sentence: It was Tom who he ate the last piece of cake.
detective.fixed: It was Tom who ate the last piece of cake.
detective.clue: Tom 已经进了光圈，原位不能再留个 he——复本要清场。

detective.sentence: It is last night that the concert was held in the hall.
detective.fixed: It was last night that the concert was held in the hall.
detective.clue: 昨晚是过去——灯架要用过去款 It was。

detective.sentence: It was my grandpa that grow these vegetables.
detective.fixed: It is my grandpa that grows these vegetables.
detective.clue: 种菜是现在的习惯——It is；that 后动词跟 grandpa 对齐加 -s。

detective.sentence: It was until midnight that he finished the model plane.
detective.fixed: It was not until midnight that he finished the model plane.
detective.clue: 「直到才」进光圈要整块搬——not 丢了，意思就断了。

detective.sentence: It was Mr Wu which gave us the map of the old town.
detective.fixed: It was Mr Wu that/who gave us the map of the old town.
detective.clue: 强调人用 that 或 who——which 进不了这个灯架。

detective.sentence: It was on Tuesday when the new timetable started.
detective.fixed: It was on Tuesday that the new timetable started.
detective.clue: 时间进光圈照样 that——when 是初中考试最爱挖的坑。
